name: LUT University
summary: Tech and business university in Lappeenranta and Lahti; 12 English bachelor's with published IB criteria: meet them and you are in while places last.

ib.text: 24 or more IB points and the Diploma awarded; an IB completed in English proves your English. Upload your predicted grades when you apply.

programmes.name: Chemical and Process Engineering
programmes.about: Sustainable production processes, separation methods and process design on a base of chemistry, physics and maths, applied to the circular economy, green energy and biomass.
programmes.overview: You study mathematics, chemistry, physics and renewable energy together with separation technologies and process development, covering chemical reactions, mixing and flows with applications in biorefineries, water treatment and food processing. Teaching combines extensive laboratory work, lectures, company visits and group projects, and ends with a bachelor's thesis. Process design, simulation, AI and safety are part of the toolkit, with a focus on sustainable production and the circular economy. Graduates work as process designers, environmental specialists or development engineers, or continue to master's programmes in energy transition, food processing or water technology.

programmes.name: Civil Engineering
programmes.about: Civil engineering for the energy transition, urbanisation, resource efficiency, climate change and digitalisation, taught in Lahti, with direct progression to a related master's.
programmes.overview: You study structural engineering in steel, timber and concrete, sustainable materials, building information modelling and data management, infrastructure such as energy systems, water management and transport, and the built environment in society. Teaching mixes lectures, exercises, company visits, projects and laboratory work, including exercises in virtual environments and materials laboratories, and the final semester is a bachelor's thesis research project. You study alongside students of Sustainable Construction Technology, with cooperation from LAB University of Applied Sciences and industry; teaching is mainly in Lahti. Graduates work as structural and infrastructure engineers, BIM specialists, development managers or urban planners.

programmes.name: Computational Science and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Mathematics and computer science combined to solve real scientific and engineering problems through mathematical modelling, algorithms and data.
programmes.overview: You study mathematics, statistics, computer science, numerical methods and programming, then specialise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, matrix calculus, optimisation and partial differential equations, with minors such as software engineering, energy economics or business management. Teaching combines lectures and exercises with company visits, projects, extensive laboratory work and a bachelor's thesis. Mathematics and computer science are merged to solve practical problems with algorithms and data analysis. Graduates work as data analysts, data scientists, machine learning engineers and AI specialists, and can move on to the master's programme in data-centric engineering.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering
programmes.about: How electrical energy is generated, transmitted and used: clean energy, smart grids, solar power, electrical machines, automation and power electronics.
programmes.overview: You study electrical energy systems, electrical machines, electronics, embedded systems and mechatronics, on a base of mathematics, physics and programming, with practical skills in measurement and design. Teaching combines lectures and exercises with extensive laboratory work, company visits and projects, and you can add a minor such as energy economics or sustainability science. Graduates work as electrical, test, embedded systems and project engineers in energy, manufacturing, technology and transport. The degree leads to master's programmes in electrical engineering, electric transportation systems or renewable power-to-X economy, or to double-degree master's options in Wroclaw or Hannover.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering (HEBUT double degree)
programmes.about: Electrical engineering for renewable energy and energy efficiency, studied entirely in Finland, earning degree certificates from both LUT and Hebei University of Technology, China.
programmes.overview: This double degree covers mathematics, physics, engineering design, mechanics, electronics and control systems, then moves into power systems, electrical drives, circuits, digital design, mechatronics and embedded systems. Alongside the engineering, you study basic Chinese, Finnish and English, and can add a minor such as energy economics or innovation and entrepreneurship. Lectures, exercises, laboratory work, company visits and projects lead to a bachelor's thesis, and you complete the whole degree in Finland while earning certificates from both LUT and Hebei University of Technology. Graduates work as project, test, design and technical sales engineers, or continue to master's studies at LUT.

programmes.name: Energy Technology
programmes.about: Efficient, environmentally friendly production and distribution of energy: energy conversion processes and the machinery of energy systems.
programmes.overview: You study thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, nuclear power engineering, power plant engineering and energy economics, covering how electricity and heat are produced from solar, wind, thermal and nuclear sources. Mathematics, physics, design, control systems and programming support the core, and minors include electronics and sustainability science. Teaching uses lectures, extensive laboratory work, company visits and projects, and ends with a bachelor's thesis. Nuclear safety studies are offered only at this university in Finland. Graduates work as development and design engineers, reactor engineers and nuclear safety specialists, or continue to a master's in energy conversion, nuclear engineering or sustainable energy systems.

programmes.name: Environmental Technology
programmes.about: How environmental problems connect to energy systems, cities, industry, natural resources and well-being, and how to design sustainable solutions.
programmes.overview: You study engineering mathematics, physics, chemistry, programming, thermodynamics and fluid mechanics, then life cycle assessment, sustainable cities, wind and solar technologies, climate solutions and the circular economy. Teaching mixes lectures with individual and group projects, laboratory work, modelling assignments and company visits, using real challenges from industry, cities and society. You choose a minor such as energy economics, international business or computational science. Graduates work in environmental management, sustainability assessment, climate action, clean technology and urban development, or continue to master's programmes in circular economy or sustainability science.

programmes.name: Industrial Engineering and Management
programmes.about: Technology and business combined: using engineering problem-solving to analyse and develop business operations in digitalising industry.
programmes.overview: You study industrial engineering and industrial economy on a base of mathematics, physics and software engineering, then specialise in areas such as innovation management, product and service development, entrepreneurship, business analytics, supply chain management and marketing, with attention to digital transformation and sustainability. Teaching combines lectures, company visits, projects and laboratory work, with close industry collaboration that opens internship opportunities, and a thesis in the last semester. Graduates work as industrial engineers, supply chain and investment analysts, quality engineers and business controllers, or continue to master's programmes in innovation, logistics or organisational development.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: Creative product development, design and modelling combined with automated, robotised production, digital tools and the circular economy.
programmes.overview: You study mathematics, physics, engineering design, mechanics, materials and control systems, then specialise in mechatronics, robotics, production engineering, finite element analysis and machine design, with attention to digital design environments and the product life cycle. Teaching combines lectures, exercises, projects and extensive laboratory work, and students can use the Jamie Hyneman Center prototyping lab. Minors include energy economics and sustainability science. Graduates work as design engineers, production managers and product development engineers in machinery, automotive, energy and healthcare, or continue to master's programmes in industrial design engineering, materials science, mechanical engineering or mechatronics.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering (HEBUT double degree)
programmes.about: Product development and modern manufacturing, studied entirely in Finland, earning degree certificates from both LUT and Hebei University of Technology, China.
programmes.overview: This double degree with Hebei University of Technology covers engineering physics, mathematics, mechanics, 3D engineering, materials, energy systems, measurement and control, robotics, mechatronics and AI-driven machinery, with Chinese language study throughout. Teaching combines lectures, company visits, projects and extensive laboratory work, including the Jamie Hyneman prototyping lab, and ends with a bachelor's thesis. A minor can be energy economics, sustainability science or Chinese business and culture, and you receive degrees from both universities. Graduates work as design engineers, production and quality managers and product development engineers in automotive, energy, food, healthcare and construction.

programmes.name: Software and Systems Engineering (HEBUT double degree)
programmes.about: Programming and software engineering for societal problems, studied in Lahti, earning degree certificates from both LUT and Hebei University of Technology, China.
programmes.overview: You study object-oriented programming, discrete mathematics, data structures and algorithms, computer networks, cybersecurity, web applications and IoT-based systems, plus basic Chinese, Finnish and English. Teaching combines lectures, company visits, projects and extensive laboratory work, and the degree closes with a bachelor's thesis; the curriculum stresses sustainable development and digital transformation. It is a double degree with Hebei University of Technology, taught entirely in Finland, with certificates from both universities. Graduates work as software developers, testing and automation engineers or business analysts, or continue to master's programmes in software engineering or digital systems.

programmes.name: Technology and Engineering Science
programmes.about: A multidisciplinary engineering degree mixing mechanical, electrical, energy and environmental technology with language studies and entrepreneurship.
programmes.overview: You start with engineering mathematics, physics, mechanics, thermodynamics, 3D modelling and technical documentation, linking mechanical, electrical, energy and environmental technology with IoT skills. In the intermediate studies you choose a direction: energy technology, electrical engineering, environmental technology or mechanical engineering. Teaching combines lectures, company visits, projects and extensive laboratory work, and the degree holds EUR-ACE and ASIIN accreditation. It opens the way to many English-language master's programmes in energy, electrical, mechanical and environmental engineering, or to careers as engineers, project managers and sustainability consultants.

programmes.name: Digital Business
programmes.about: Business for a digital economy: digital technologies, digital fluency and strategy for growth, in Lahti; admits you to a 3+2 bachelor's and master's.
programmes.overview: You study digital business models, digital sustainability, business information systems, AI applications, data-driven management and digital transformation, alongside accounting, finance, economics, leadership and marketing. Studies are on campus in Lahti with lectures, company visits and practical projects, a minor in industrial engineering or software and information systems, and a research-based bachelor's thesis; exchange periods are encouraged. Graduates work as digital marketing specialists, product or service managers, business developers and analytics or transformation specialists, or continue to master's programmes in international business and entrepreneurship, international marketing or supply management.

programmes.name: Sustainable International Business
programmes.about: Sustainable management of international business: operations, marketing and supply management in a changed global landscape; 3+2 bachelor's and master's.
programmes.overview: You study accounting, finance, economics, management and strategy, then specialise in international business, sustainable business, international entrepreneurship, international marketing and purchasing, or professional sales. Sustainability is treated as a driver of changing business models, and extensive language, communication and diversity studies build a multicultural outlook. Lectures, exercises, company visits and projects are the main ways of working. Graduates work as business development, international sales, supply chain or export managers, or continue to master's programmes in international business and entrepreneurship, supply management or international marketing.

notes: Admission is not competitive: if you meet every requirement you get a place, as long as the programme has places left.
The first place you confirm in Finland is final, so accepting LUT in the spring rules out any later Finnish offer for autumn 2027.
LUT's IB subject table is still headed '2026 Entry requirements'; check it again before you apply.
